_types: A list = allowed values (first one is the default). "text" = any short text. "text*" = required text. "bool" = true/false. "color" = "#RRGGBB".

Sky.about: The host stands on a low-poly hill under the sky. Use for the hook, reactions, everyday effects and the ending.

Planet.about: Low-poly Earth in space with an optional Moon. Use for planet-scale effects (tides, tilt, orbit).

StatCard.about: One big number or word with a label. Use for a key fact the viewer must remember.
